title: The Ardabil carpets receive dated inscriptions
summary: The paired Ardabil carpets carry inscriptions naming Maqsud of Kashan and the year AH 946, corresponding to 1539–1540 CE.

claims.text: The paired Ardabil carpets carry inscriptions naming Maqsud of Kashan and the year AH 946, corresponding to 1539–1540 CE.
The two CE years express the inscribed Hijri year, not a two-year weaving duration. The museums supply the conversion.
Their wool pile forms a medallion and hanging-lamp design. Maqsud probably supervised the work; the original commission and weaving location remain uncertain.

review.corroboration: V&A and LACMA accounts agree on AH 946 / 1539–40. Both qualify the commission and Maqsud’s role; their shared attribution is not certainty.
